teaser.en: Ask for 'pindi sita za muwa' and you will be handed a piece of sugar cane six joints long.
teaser.sw: Ukiomba *pindi sita za muwa*, utapewa kipande cha muwa chenye pingili sita.
teaser.dg: Uchivoya '*pindi sita za muwa*', undahewa chipande cha muwa chenye pindi sita.

summary.en: *Muwa* is sugar cane, a tall jointed grass with sweet, juicy stems. It is grown in garden patches and was once farmed on a large estate at Ramisi.
summary.sw: *Muwa* ni mmea mrefu wa jamii ya nyasi wenye pingili na mashina matamu yenye maji mengi. Hupandwa katika vipande vidogo vya bustani, na zamani ulilimwa katika shamba kubwa huko Ramisi.
summary.dg: *Muwa* ni mmea mure wa jamii ya nyasi wenye pindi, na mihiye ni ya mtswano na ina madzi manji. Unaphandwa kpwenye minda midide ya kaya, na kare kala unarimwa kpwenye munda mkulu sana wa Ramisi.

about.en:
*Muwa* is a tall, thick-stemmed grass that grows in clumps, its stems divided into joints like bamboo. The leaves are long and narrow with sharp edges. The stems can be green, yellow or purple, depending on the variety, and are filled with sweet, juicy fibre.

A single joint-length of cane is a *pindi*.
about.sw:
*Muwa* ni nyasi ndefu yenye mashina manene inayokua kwa vichaka, na mashina yake yamegawanyika kwa pingili kama mianzi. Majani yake ni marefu na membamba yenye kingo kali. Mashina yanaweza kuwa ya kijani, njano au zambarau, kutegemea aina, na yamejaa nyuzi tamu zenye maji mengi.

Urefu wa pingili moja ya muwa huitwa *pindi*.
about.dg:
*Muwa* ni mmea mure wa jamii ya nyasi wenye mihi minene, unaomera kpwa makundi, na mihiye ina mafundo dza mianzi. Makodzage ni mare na membamba, genye kanda zenye makali. Kpwa aina za tafwauti, mihi ni ya chijani, ya rangi ya mandano au ya zambarau, na ina nyuzi za mtswano zenye madzi manji.

Chipande cha muwa kahi ya fundo na fundo ni *pindi*.

where.en: Sugar cane grows in garden patches near homesteads, often on damp ground. On the south coast, the Ramisi area was home to a sugar estate, now closed.
where.sw: Miwa hukua katika vipande vya bustani karibu na makazi, mara nyingi kwenye ardhi yenye unyevunyevu. Pwani ya kusini, eneo la Ramisi lilikuwa na shamba kubwa la miwa, ambalo sasa limefungwa.
where.dg: *Muwa* unamera kpwenye minda midide phephi na midzi, mara nyinji kpwenye tsi yenye chinemi. Pwani ya kusini, eneo ra Ramisi kala rina munda mkulu wa sukari, ambao sambi ukafungbwa.

uses.en: Cane is cut into lengths, peeled with a knife and chewed fresh for its sweet juice. The chewed-out fibres left behind are called *vwanda*.
uses.sw: Muwa hukatwa vipande, humenywa kwa kisu na kutafunwa ukiwa mbichi ili kufyonza maji yake matamu. Makapi yanayobaki baada ya kutafunwa huitwa *vwanda*.
uses.dg: Miwa nkukatwa vipande, nkugandulwa kpwa rumu na nkuafunwa dza irivyo kuphaha madzige ga mtswano. Nyuzi zinazosala bada ya kuafunwa nkuihwa *vwanda*.

culture.en: A Mgombato example sentence shows how the cane is measured: *Nipha pindi sita za muwa*, 'Give me a piece of sugar cane six sections long.'
culture.sw: Sentensi ya mfano katika Mgombato inaonyesha jinsi muwa unavyopimwa: *Nipha pindi sita za muwa*, 'Nipe kipande cha muwa chenye pingili sita.'
culture.dg: Mfwano mmwenga wa Mgombato unaonyesa muwa unavyopimwa: *Nipha pindi sita za muwa*, 'Nipha chipande cha muwa chenye pindi sita.'

names.en: Digo: *muwa*, plural *miwa*. A joint of cane is a *pindi*, and the chewed fibres are *vwanda*. Swahili: *muwa*. English: sugar cane. Scientists call it *Saccharum officinarum*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *muwa*, wingi *miwa*. Pingili moja ya muwa ni *pindi*, na makapi yaliyotafunwa ni *vwanda*. Kiswahili: *muwa*. Kwa Kiingereza: *sugar cane*. Wanasayansi huuita *Saccharum officinarum*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *muwa*, unji *miwa*. Chipande chimwenga cha muwa ni *pindi*, na nyuzi zirizoafunwa ni *vwanda*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *muwa*, kpwa Chingereza *sugar cane*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Saccharum officinarum*.

definition.en: A section of sugarcane between two joints, about 15 cm long. Mgombato: 'Nipha pindi sita za muwa', 'give me a piece six sections long' (about a metre).
definition.sw: Sehemu ya muwa kati ya vifundo viwili, yenye urefu wa takriban sm 15. Mgombato: 'Nipha pindi sita za muwa', 'nipe kipande chenye pingili sita' (takriban mita moja).
definition.dg: Chipande cha muwa kahi ya fundo na fundo, cha sm 15 hivi. Mgombato: 'Nipha pindi sita za muwa', 'nipha chipande chenye pindi sita' (mita mwenga hivi).

definition.en: The feathery flower head of sugarcane.
definition.sw: Ua la muwa lenye umbo la unyoya.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra dzulu ra muwa, ririro dza manyoya.

definition.en: The fibres left after sugarcane has been chewed.
definition.sw: Makapi yanayobaki baada ya muwa kutafunwa.
definition.dg: Nyuzi zinazosala bada ya muwa kuafunwa.
